basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of Minecraft and LEGO, I spend most of my free time building intricate structures both in-game and in real life. Living in Manchester, UK, I work as a junior graphic designer and enjoy the creative process of bringing ideas to life. I am single, and usually online during evenings and weekends, especially when new Minecraft updates are released or a LEGO set catches my eye. I dislike spoilers and unsolicited advice on my builds.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied at a local art college. My expertise in design translates into my passion for creating both digital and physical models. I am mostly self-taught in Minecraft, with countless hours spent watching YouTube tutorials and participating in online forums.
